newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Dos Bocas port closed, Pajaritos reopens.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Dos Bocas port closed, Pajaritos reopens.

text.p: Mexico's crude shipment port Dos Bocas remained closed on Sunday, but the Pajaritos port reopened after a 19-hour shut-down, officials said.
A port official at Dos Bocas said it continued to suffer from waves eight- to 10-feet high and strong winds.
In the crude shipping center of Pajaritos, an official said the port was reopened at 0700 local time/1200 GMT, after a shutdown since midday on Saturday.
The Communications and Transport Ministry said in a statement the ports of Veracruz, Tuxpan and Altamira were reopened on Sunday. They had been closed on Saturday.
